lines: Beautiful flowers adorning the night sky
The light gently wraps around the voices of the town
In a soundless world for just the two of us, the words I heard were
"I love you"
The future I saw in my dream
A summer night, with you, two shadows side by side
When the last firework rises into the sky and fades
That will be our signal
Back to an ordinary morning
You, looking just like always
The reason I couldn't help but look away
Your words, no matter what, unforgettable
Still echoing in me even now
Through the night, beyond the dream
Toward the future I want to reach
Really? That dream, really? Even now
I end up anxious, but surely
Past this moment, beyond tomorrow
To a place for just the two of us
Just a little longer
Please don't change
Just a little longer
Words from you
I'll be waiting in that future
That no one else knows
A night for just the two of us
It overlaps with the scenery I've been burning for
Fireworks blooming in the summer sky, as if linking future and now
With you here, look, we're tracing that dream
The light adorning the sky I looked up at now lit up your face in profile
Yes, all this time, for this scenery
Yes, surely, look, our two futures
Now overlap as one
In the night, the two of us together
In the future we finally reached
It's all right, this longing will surely, it's all right, get through
Beyond the dream I saw that day
Past this moment, beyond tomorrow
To you, whom I could meet again
Just a little longer
Please don't end
Just a little longer
Look, the last firework now
Wraps around the two of us
Echoing through the soundless world
"I love you"
